translations.web: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.
translations.bsb: On the third day after I gave birth, this woman also had a baby. We were alone, with no one in the house but the two of us.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
translations.asv: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
